description.value: Heavenly Desserts is a premium dessert restaurant franchise originating in the UK in 2008, now with multiple Canadian locations. The Victoria outpost serves signature dishes including the Croffle (a croissant-waffle hybrid), elaborate American waffles, milk cakes, and crêpes, all with full table service. Each location features unique, elegantly designed interiors described as atmospheric and refined.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Heavenly Desserts is an active international dessert restaurant franchise with a Canadian presence, matching the OSM name and URL. The website provides no evidence for bike parking, water refill, or washroom access, and OSM tags offer no supplementary cycling amenity data either. Delivery partners are mentioned on the contact page, weakly implying takeout exists, but this cannot be confirmed as specific to the Victoria location from the fetched content alone.
concerns: Website does not confirm the specific Victoria address (456a Gorge Road East); the restaurant locator page content was not captured in the fetch.
Phone number listed in OSM (+12505900058) is not corroborated by the website content — could not verify it is the Victoria-specific number rather than a central number.
Franchise website is shared across all Canadian locations; location-specific amenity details (parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are directed to a restaurant locator that was not fetched.
OSM tags outdoor_seating=no — corroborated by absence of any mention of outdoor seating on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is confirmed open and legitimate, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be verified from the website or OSM tags. A direct visit or phone inquiry is needed to confirm whether this dessert restaurant meets minimum accreditation requirements.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website references 'East Menu' and 'West Menu' suggesting at least two Canadian locations; it is unclear whether 456a Gorge Road East is the East or West location. The upcoming second Canadian location blog post (May 2024) may mean a second Victoria-area or BC location exists or is planned.

Packed lunches.detail: Dessert-only menu (waffles, croffles, crêpes, mochi, macarons); no sandwiches, wraps, or packable savoury items listed

wow_evidence: premium dessert restaurant franchise originating in the UK in 2008, now with multiple Canadian locations
